slides.title: Three things to tell owners this week
slides.so_what: Hold asking rents in the core; price City assets off the Churchill Place evidence.
slides.notes: Each pillar maps to one data slide in the board pack.

pillars.head: Demand is building
pillars.body: Active requirements are up to 14.30m sq ft and take-up of 3.10m sq ft is 11% above the long-term average.

pillars.head: Core rents are holding
pillars.body: West End Core leads at £185/sq ft and few submarkets moved on the quarter.

pillars.head: Capital is selective
pillars.body: Investment of £2.00bn is 36% below the long-term average; City & Southbank is 77% below its own.
